column3: Tenaru River (GeoNames stream entry; elevation ca. 9 m, not the mouth)
column14: GeoNames has TWO rivers: Tenaru River (this one) and Ilu River (19-P05, 2.9 km farther west by the printed coordinates: longitude 160.06990 against 160.09602). The Marine histories used here (Miller) call the 1942 river the Ilu; Zimmerman and Hoffman call the first battle the Tenaru. Which of the two GeoNames streams is the 1942 sand-bar river is not decided by GeoNames; the lead decides. The Tenaru Beach entry (-9.42901, 160.08434) lies between the two stream points. Found beside a lead from an outside research pass (Nov 14, 2026), checked against the source.
